w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Terms of Service. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Callback, Ad Break, The Algorithm, The Eulogy) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🧳 A traveler from southeast says Thornfield is starving — Nadia's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1020 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/11/7), with 6 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Merge fully. No way back."

◈ Maria Salazar reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.

plan.why: Nobody is here to feast with.
